business.text: Who we are We are a manufacturer of critical products across the solar component ecosystem, comprising solar glass, aluminium frames, encapsulants such as ethylene vinyl acetate (“EVA”) and expandable polyethylene (“EPE”), and back sheets for solar panels, which are collectively among the foundational components of a solar module. According to the CRISIL Report, we are among the few companies in India positioned across multiple critical components of the solar module value chain.

emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – Vishakha Renewables Limited
emails.text:
Dear Aradhy Rajyaguru and Raghavendra Bhat,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of Vishakha Renewables Limited, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated September 30, 2026 has been filed with SEBI for listing on the Main Board of BSE and NSE.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON VISHAKHA RENEWABLES
We have studied the DRHP of Vishakha Renewables closely, and the business and its growth trajectory fit well with our investment focus.

Key financials (restated, ₹ crore unless stated)
                                       FY26       FY25       FY24
Revenue from operations (₹ cr)        1,893      1,517      1,004
Growth (YoY)                          24.8%      51.2%          –
EBITDA (₹ cr)                        389.94     237.40     184.31
EBITDA margin                         20.6%      15.6%      18.4%
Profit after tax (₹ cr)              173.45      62.87      83.48
PAT margin                             9.2%       4.1%       8.3%
Source: restated financial information in the DRHP; EBITDA and ratios computed from it.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO placement: The DRHP contemplates a Pre-IPO Placement of up to 20% of the Fresh Issue. We would be keen to participate in this round.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of Vishakha Renewables (Jigish Nagindas Doshi, Akshat Jigishbhai Doshi and Gautam S. Adani) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
WhatsApp: +91 83200 52970
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70690 06298
